results.name: actor_mode_maybe_advance
results.evidence: Reads actor mode field at +0x6c; for modes 5/7/8 checks flags at +0x9c/+0x9d and a counter at +0xa4 before invoking per-mode helpers (FUN_0041fb00/60/c0) and a common cleanup FUN_0040cdf0.
results.summary: Checks whether the actor's current special mode (5, 7, or 8) is ready to proceed and, if so, invokes the matching per-mode helper before a common cleanup step.

results.name: actor_set_mode
results.evidence: Takes actor index, new mode number, optional data buffer; fires the exit callback for the old mode via DAT_0065526c[mode*0x38], updates a look-time bound from DAT_00655258[mode], clears a scratch buffer, copies the caller's data into +0x9c, stores the new mode at +0x6c, then fires the entry callback DAT_0065525c[mode*0x38].
results.summary: Central actor mode setter: runs the outgoing mode's exit callback, updates housekeeping fields, copies mode-specific data, and runs the new mode's entry callback.

results.name: actor_can_throw_grenade_at_target
results.evidence: Looks up a grenade-projectile tag record, checks the actor has no in-flight grenade (+0x158), rolls a random_real/datum_get style check, then validates a clear ballistic path via FUN_00410c90 (candidate point), FUN_00410da0 (danger check) and FUN_00411180 (trajectory build).
results.summary: Determines whether the actor can currently throw a grenade at its target by validating a clear, safe trajectory.

results.name: actor_update_grenade_throw_facing
results.evidence: Uses vector2d_normalize_with_length on facing-vs-target vectors and compares the dot product against 0.8660254 (cos 30 deg); on success sets flag +0x45c=1, clears +0x6a0, and stamps a perception-record timestamp from DAT_006f1d6c+0xc (game time).
results.summary: Checks whether the actor is now facing closely enough toward its grenade target and, if so, commits to the throw and timestamps the threat record.

results.name: actor_update_grenade_throw_desire
results.evidence: Bails if grenade projectile tag fields at +0x180/+0x182 are unset; otherwise computes a randomized throw-chance timer from tag fields +0x1a0/+0x1a4 vs game time, rolls random_real() against it, and on success calls actor_can_throw_grenade_at_target then actor_update_grenade_throw_facing.
results.summary: Periodically rolls whether the actor decides to throw a grenade, using a randomized cooldown/probability from its grenade tag data.

results.name: actor_notify_death
results.evidence: Proceeds only if a death flag at +0x160 is unset; clears a current-threat reference (+0x270) via FUN_004208a0, calls FUN_00403f00 when not already leaving, and on success calls actor_set_mode(actor, 4, buffer).
results.summary: One-time actor death handling that clears its current threat and transitions it into mode 4 (death handling).

results.name: actor_maybe_play_pain_response
results.evidence: Simple wrapper: calls FUN_00403630 as a boolean gate and, if true, calls actor_set_mode.
results.summary: Checks a pain/reaction condition and transitions the actor into the associated mode if satisfied.

results.name: actor_can_throw_grenade_toward_threat
results.evidence: Bails if already targeting (+0x158/+0x418) or already facing threat (FUN_00569c90); requires a valid threat record (+0x270) with grenade radius >0, computes a direction to the threat and dot-products it against the actor's forward vector (>0.4), then gates further via FUN_00417e50/FUN_00569470 before requesting a throw with FUN_00417a60(6, dir).
results.summary: Evaluates whether the actor's current threat is positioned well enough to grenade and, if so, requests a grenade throw toward it.

results.name: actor_select_and_play_dialogue_line
results.evidence: Iterates a short array of dialogue-line indices (caller-supplied or from FUN_0056a310), skipping -1/rejected-by-FUN_00565150 lines, validates each with FUN_00408a30, and on the first valid one calls actor_set_mode(actor, 9, buffer) and marks the slot consumed (0xffff).
results.summary: Picks the first still-valid vocalization line from a candidate list and triggers the actor to play it via mode 9.

results.name: actor_targets_match
results.evidence: Compares the threat descriptor (short pair at +0xa4, valid only in modes 5/7) of two actor indices; type 0 uses datum_get() plus a FUN_00401020 random threshold (<0.49), type 1 compares stored ids, type 2 always matches.
results.summary: Determines whether two actors are considered to share the same target/threat descriptor, with a random tie-break for the ambiguous case.

results.name: actor_is_valid_grenade_candidate
results.evidence: Looks up an actor handle using the standard data-array bounds/stride pattern (DAT_00880360+0x20 count, +0x22 stride, +0x34 base), then checks its mode-class field (offsets 0x36/0x37 in {5,6,7,8}) and a per-team flag from PTR_PTR_006853b8[team][0xc].
results.summary: Validates a candidate actor (by handle) as eligible for a grenade-related interaction based on its current mode and team.

results.name: actor_find_nearest_valid_grenade_target
results.evidence: Walks the actor's local list (+0x50, DAT_008802c0-indexed records) validating members via actor_is_valid_grenade_candidate and tracking the closest by +0x11c; falls back to walking a wider list gated by DAT_00880354 comparing 3D distance; stores the closest handle at +0x1d0.
results.summary: Counts and finds the nearest eligible ally actor for a coordinated grenade attack and records it on the actor.

results.name: actor_get_mode_flag
results.evidence: Indexes DAT_00655258 (the same per-mode property table used by actor_set_mode's look-time comparison) by the actor's current mode field at +0x6c.
results.summary: Returns a per-mode property value from the mode definition table for the actor's currently active mode.

results.name: actor_get_vocalization_table_entry
results.evidence: Bounds-checks in_CX against 0..11 and indexes a fixed 12-entry table DAT_006555a8 that parallels the mode tables used near actor_set_mode/dialogue selection.
results.summary: Looks up an entry in a small fixed-size table by index, returning zero if the index is out of range.

results.name: actor_update_combat_tick
results.evidence: Decrements several per-actor cooldown timers (+0x5f4/0x5f6/0x5f8/0x5fc), re-derives the active threat class (+0x60c), drives a movement/desired-position state machine on +0x5f2 (states 0-4) calling actor_update_movement_goal (FUN_0040fcb0), FUN_004104e0 and FUN_004105c0, and updates aim-lead vectors via FUN_0040f9b0/FUN_0042b270.
results.summary: The actor's main per-tick combat/movement update: refreshes cooldowns, re-derives the current threat, and drives the movement/aiming state machine.

results.name: actor_grenade_type_allowed
results.evidence: Switches on a requested grenade kind (1/2/3), gating on the actor's combat mode field (+0x60c) and a combat-duration counter (+0x268), plus per-kind extra flags (+0x27c/+0x278, +0x161).
results.summary: Checks mode- and timing-based gating rules to decide whether a particular grenade behavior kind is currently allowed for the actor.

results.name: actor_grenade_target_still_valid
results.evidence: Only checks when param_1==3: looks up the current grenade-target threat record (+0x610) and returns true unless it has no weapon (+0x110==-1) and its danger score from FUN_00410da0 is <=2.
results.summary: For grenade-target kind 3, revalidates that the previously chosen target is still a good throw candidate.

results.name: actor_compute_grenade_throw_point
results.evidence: For combat mode 2, derives a target weapon type from the current grenade-target record, computes an aim direction toward a stored point (+0x67c) or fixed offset (+0x68c), checks the dot product against a forward cone (0.8660254), and if outside it, builds a corrective perpendicular via vector3d_build_perpendicular/vector3d_rotate_about_axis.
results.summary: Computes the aim direction for a grenade throw, nudging it away from a too-close firing line when needed.

results.name: actor_get_current_unit_actor_definition
results.evidence: Calls FUN_004282c0 to get a unit handle, then looks up its associated tag/definition block via the object table (DAT_008603b0) and tag-block accessor (DAT_0087bc14), returning 0 if there is no current unit.
results.summary: Resolves the actor's current possessed unit to its associated actor-type tag definition block.

results.name: actor_get_eye_or_weapon_position
results.evidence: Uses the actor's current object handle (+0x18), or if flag +0x161 is set its target handle (+0x158) instead; returns the stored eye-position (+0x74/+0x78/+0x7c) when object flag bit 0x100000 is set, else the base object position (+0x23c/+0x240/+0x244) via FUN_005697a0.
results.summary: Returns the 3D position to aim/look from for the actor (its eye offset if flagged, otherwise its object's base position).

results.name: actor_get_actor_definition
results.evidence: Called from 11 sites; default result comes from the actor's own type-tag data (+0x5c indexed record) but returns a per-unit override definition (+0x3c8 on the unit's actor block) when that override is set, via FUN_004282c0.
results.summary: Returns the actor definition (tag data block) to use, preferring a possessed unit's actor-type override when present.

results.name: actor_pick_random_nearby_point
results.evidence: Builds a random point on a circle of radius param_1 around a base offset (1.5 units ahead along PTR_DAT_00696720) using an LCG on DAT_00719cd0, then validates it with FUN_00505880 and shrinks the radius toward the actor if the line is blocked.
results.summary: Chooses a randomized point within a given radius of the actor, pulling it back toward the actor if the line to it is obstructed.

results.name: actor_update_movement_goal
results.evidence: Recomputes desired facing/turn-rate caps, calls actor_pick_random_nearby_point for grenade-avoidance nudging, builds a randomized wander direction with the same LCG, writes velocity/position deltas (+0x64c..+0x684), and fires an idle/stuck event via FUN_0042d340 when +0x6e exceeds 6.
results.summary: Recomputes the actor's desired movement destination and velocity each tick, applying randomized wander and turn-rate limits.

results.name: actor_reset_move_pause_timer
results.evidence: Fetches the actor definition (FUN_0040fa70) and stance offsets (FUN_004106b0), rolls the LCG, and reseeds the +0x5f4 timer via FUN_006391b4.
results.summary: Reseeds the actor's short movement-pause timer with a new randomized value.

results.name: actor_should_hold_position
results.evidence: If the actor has a grenade target (+0x60c==1) whose weapon class is 4 or 5, forces a flee flag (+0x3bc=1) and returns false; if a stay-put flag (+0x457) is set returns it directly; otherwise reseeds the +0x5f4 timer via FUN_006391b4 and returns true.
results.summary: Decides whether the actor should currently hold its position, forcing a flee for dangerous-weapon threats.

results.name: actor_get_stance_offsets
results.evidence: Given a base struct pointer, writes two output pointers selecting between +0xcc/+0x130, +0x100, +0x118, or 0 depending on crouch (+0x378), cover (+0x600) and lean (+0x601) flags.
results.summary: Selects which stance-specific offset pair (crouching, in-cover, leaning) to use for subsequent position math.

results.name: actor_store_grenade_impact_point
results.evidence: Validates a candidate grenade-projectile tag pair via FUN_00410da0 and, if the area is clear, stores an incoming point into the actor's throw-impact fields (+0x6a8/+0x6ac/+0x6b0).
results.summary: Validates and records a candidate grenade impact point on the actor if the area is clear.

results.name: actor_compute_grenade_lob_solution
results.evidence: Looks up a weapon-class throw-arc record via DAT_00746fa0, calls FUN_004beec0 (a ballistic-arc solver) with the actor's facing/grenade parameters, checks the resulting direction lies within a 0.8660254 forward cone, and if so commits via FUN_0042b5d0 and stores the solved lob parameters (+0x6bc..+0x6c8).
results.summary: Solves for a grenade lob trajectory toward the target and commits it if the throw direction is acceptably forward-facing.

results.name: actor_get_grenade_launch_velocity
results.evidence: Looks up a weapon-class record via DAT_00746fa0/in_AX, calls FUN_004beec0 for the ballistic solve, and on success scales the resulting direction by a launch speed and writes optional velocity/gravity-scale output pointers.
results.summary: Computes and returns a grenade launch velocity vector (and optional gravity scale) for the given throw parameters.

results.name: actor_get_grenade_throw_direction
results.evidence: Resolves the grenade-target weapon type from the threat record at +0x6b4 (class 2-3 check), calls actor_store_grenade_impact_point/actor_compute_grenade_lob_solution, and when no live grenade projectile exists (+0x158==-1) re-orients the impact offset toward the actor's forward cone using vector3d_rotate_about_axis before scaling by the solved throw speed.
results.summary: Produces the final grenade throw direction vector, correcting it toward the actor's facing cone when needed.

results.name: actor_find_grenade_landing_point
results.evidence: Looks up the actor's current threat record (+0x270) and, if it is within the actor definition's near/far grenade-range band (+0x194/+0x198 vs +0x11c), outputs its position (with a +0.2 vertical bump) plus the threat and weapon handles.
results.summary: Finds a suitable grenade landing point at the current threat's position when it is within the actor's configured grenade range.

results.name: actor_evaluate_grenade_blast_area
results.evidence: Given a point and two radii, walks the actor's nearby-threat list (+0x50) tallying a weighted danger score for hostiles within radius param_1, then walks the encounter-wide actor list (gated by DAT_00880354) checking for friendlies within radius param_2 of the point, and finally the actor's own local list; returns whether the area is clear and outputs the accumulated danger tally via param_4.
results.summary: Scores hostiles within a blast radius of a point and checks no friendlies are within a safety radius, returning whether the spot is clear to throw at.

results.name: actor_finalize_grenade_toss
results.evidence: Computes a launch velocity via actor_get_grenade_launch_velocity toward a landing point (param_1) and, if accepted by FUN_0042b5d0's arc validation, commits the throw parameters into the actor's grenade-toss fields (+0x6a8..+0x6c8) and clears the targeted flag (+0x6a1).
results.summary: Computes and commits the final grenade toss parameters once a valid landing solution has been accepted.

results.name: actor_score_candidate_points_los
results.evidence: Iterates a list of candidate points (param_4, per-point 0xf-word stride) adding danger weight based on proximity to the segment between two positions via point3d_distance_squared_to_segment/segment3d_distance_squared_to_segment, team-avoidance masks (param_2+0x48/+0x4c) and nearby danger volumes (param_2+0x50 list); also scores points against nearby allies' facing via object_get_position within a forward cone.
results.summary: Adds danger weighting to a list of candidate movement points based on proximity to a threat's line of sight, marked danger zones, and allies' aim direction.

results.name: actor_score_candidate_points_hazards
results.evidence: For each candidate point (same stride/list as FUN_004112b0) adds a penalty based on distance from a grenade/blast danger radius (actor-definition fields +0x74/+0xa0/+0x16c via FUN_0040f970) and, separately, a penalty based on distance to the nearest marked avoidance plane in the actor's list (param_2+600 count at param_2+0x270).
results.summary: Further weights candidate movement points by penalizing proximity to grenade/blast danger and marked avoidance planes.

results.name: actor_score_candidate_points_recent_visits
results.evidence: Penalizes candidate points within a near-danger distance and applies a table-driven bonus/penalty (constants 0/1.5/6/8.5/10) based on how many times nearby points appear in the actor's history list (param_2+0x25c array), discouraging revisiting recent positions.
results.summary: Weights candidate movement points to discourage the actor from revisiting positions it has used recently.

results.name: actor_report_move_result
results.evidence: Given a request record whose +4 'kind' field selects among danger-point, no-target, fixed-target, or chase-target cases, builds the appropriate reason vector and calls FUN_00569190 (a look/aim-at notifier) followed by FUN_0042b270 to obtain and store a resulting status code.
results.summary: Reports the outcome of a movement/aim request back to the perception system based on the type of movement goal requested.

results.name: actor_evaluate_danger_avoidance_response
results.evidence: For a danger record whose avoid flag (param_2+0x44) is set, adds cooldown time (+0x660) when there is no candidate point, otherwise checks FUN_0041aab0/FUN_0043a0a0 against DAT_00746f9c and, on failure, marks the candidate point rejected (+0x30/+0x31).
results.summary: Applies avoidance-danger scoring to a candidate movement point, rejecting it when a required avoidance condition isn't satisfied.

results.name: actor_evaluate_time_danger_response
results.evidence: For a danger record with a time-based trigger (param_3+6/+8), queries FUN_00436b90/FUN_00436b10 keyed by the actor's target (+0x34) for a countdown/phase, then converts remaining time into a numeric penalty added to param_3+0x38 and rejects the point (+0x30/+0x31) when appropriate.
results.summary: Scores a candidate movement point against a timed hazard, penalizing points near the hazard soon and rejecting unsafe ones.

results.name: actor_evaluate_simple_danger_response
results.evidence: For a danger record flagged always-avoid (param_2+0x5fc), applies a fixed or halved penalty depending on point classification (param_3+6) and a secondary flag (param_2+0x628), rejecting the point in the default case unless the flag is set.
results.summary: Applies a simple fixed-penalty scoring rule for a candidate movement point against one class of hazard.

results.name: actor_apply_danger_scores
results.evidence: Walks a table of (bitmask, function-pointer) entries at PTR_FUN_006555c4 and, for each danger type whose bit is set in the actor's danger mask (unaff_EDI+4), calls the associated scoring callback (e.g. actor_evaluate_danger_avoidance_response).
results.summary: Dispatches to each applicable per-hazard-type scoring callback for the actor's set of active danger flags.

results.name: actor_apply_danger_rejection_checks
results.evidence: Same table-walk pattern as actor_apply_danger_scores but over PTR_FUN_006555fc, stopping as soon as a callback returns a false/zero byte, matching the accept/reject convention of actor_evaluate_*_danger_response.
results.summary: Runs applicable per-hazard rejection checks for a candidate movement point, stopping as soon as one rejects it.

results.name: actor_reset_and_apply_danger_rejection_checks
results.evidence: Identical body to actor_apply_danger_rejection_checks but first zeroes the accumulator field at unaff_EDI+0x660 before the same table walk over PTR_FUN_006555fc.
results.summary: Same per-hazard rejection dispatch as actor_apply_danger_rejection_checks, but first resets the actor's avoidance cooldown accumulator.

results.name: actor_evaluate_candidate_point_danger
results.evidence: Initializes a candidate-point record (+0x30 valid=1, +0x31=0, +0x34/+0x38=0), calls actor_apply_danger_scores to accumulate scores, then if still valid copies the score into +0x34 and runs actor_apply_danger_rejection_checks to possibly invalidate it.
results.summary: Runs the full danger-scoring and rejection pipeline for one candidate movement point, producing its final validity flag and score.

results.name: actor_get_grenade_type_index
results.evidence: Looks up the actor's unit-type grenade table record via DAT_00746f8c (tag block indexed by unit type and per-unit variant +0x3a), then, based on a request kind (unaff_SI: 1/4/5/default), returns a specific field (+0x68, one of +0x54+n*4, or +0x6c) gated by handedness flags at +0x374/+0x98.
results.summary: Resolves which grenade/weapon tag index to use for the actor for a given request kind, accounting for handedness and per-unit overrides.

results.name: actor_check_grenade_landing_clear
results.evidence: Builds a large obstruction-test record from the actor definition and passes it to FUN_0043a8b0 (the same setup pattern reused in FUN_00412ba0), then iterates hazard points in the actor-type danger list (iVar5+0x9c), testing distance <16 and calling FUN_0043a310/FUN_0043a0a0 to see if any block the shot.
results.summary: Checks whether any of the actor-type's marked hazard points obstruct a shot toward a given target position.

results.name: actor_build_combat_context
results.evidence: The largest function in this batch (4754 bytes); assembles an extensive per-tick combat-decision record (param_2, hundreds of fields) from the actor's target position/velocity, gathers nearby recognized objects and squadmates as candidate points, evaluates visibility via FUN_00420970 and grenade candidates via actor_check_grenade_landing_clear, and prepares input for the pathing/obstruction system (FUN_0043a8b0).
results.summary: Gathers and assembles the full combat-decision context for the actor (target data, nearby hazards, candidate points, visibility) used by the rest of the AI pipeline.

results.name: actor_choose_grenade_target
results.evidence: Compares grenade-type masks from actor_get_grenade_type_index(0/1/2) to pick primary vs combined secondary set, sets handedness fields, calls actor_build_combat_context; on failure falls back to a randomized 'blind throw' point from the actor-type hazard table validated via actor_evaluate_candidate_point_danger.
results.summary: Selects which grenade type to use and finds (or falls back to a randomized blind) a valid target position for the actor to throw at.

results.name: actor_set_recognized_target
results.evidence: Manages the actor's currently-recognized perception slot (+0x3b8): clears it via FUN_00417570 when in_CX==-1, evicts a conflicting owner on another actor (param_2) via FUN_004141a0, and installs/validates the new target via FUN_00417830, clearing back to -1 on failure.
results.summary: Sets or clears which perception/threat record the actor is currently recognizing, evicting any other actor previously bound to it.

results.name: actor_clear_recognition_history
results.evidence: Resets the actor's short recognition-history ring buffer (+0x3c6 count, +0x3ca.. entries reset to 0xffff) and conditionally clears the has-history flag (+0x3d8) unless a keep-on-partial-clear condition holds.
results.summary: Clears the actor's recent target-recognition history ring buffer.

results.name: actor_push_recognition_history
results.evidence: Appends a new recognized-object slot (index, flag) into the +0x3c6/+0x3ca ring buffer with modulo-4 wrapping, and stores a position snapshot (+0x3d8..+0x3e4) from the unit's hazard-point table (DAT_00746f8c).
results.summary: Pushes a newly recognized object into the actor's recognition-history ring buffer along with a position snapshot.

results.name: actor_update_flee_check
results.evidence: Manages a flee counter (+0x3ec) and a related short counter (near +0x3e8); once the counter exceeds 2 while a nonzero flee-trigger persists, calls FUN_004146c0 (a flee-direction query) and sets a currently-fleeing flag (+0x505).
results.summary: Tracks how long a flee condition has persisted and, once past a threshold, queries and commits a fleeing response.

results.name: actor_start_vocalization
results.evidence: Gates on the actor's mode class (+0x6a), a per-line minimum-mode threshold (param_1 vs +0x544), and combat-time counters; for a 'unique speaker' line (*param_3==1) checks datum_get() cooldowns on the speaker object (+0x60/+0x127/+0x5c vs a 600-tick reuse window from DAT_006f1d6c) before computing a randomized duration (DAT_00655660 table * random_real_range) and storing the chosen line/duration (+0x544..+0x558).
results.summary: Attempts to start playing a vocalization line for the actor, applying mode/cooldown gating and computing a randomized playback duration.

results.name: actor_clear_vocalization
results.evidence: Zeroes the vocalization fields set by actor_start_vocalization (+0x544, +0x546, +0x548).
results.summary: Clears the actor's currently selected vocalization/dialogue line state.

results.name: actor_get_target_priority_weight
results.evidence: Computes a priority weight for a potential threat based on its unit class (+0x24 in 2..3), disabled/dead flags (+0x60/+0x127), distance thresholds (+0x76 vs 0xd2), whether it is the actor's already-recognized target, seat occupancy at +0x110, an occupant-count multiplier at +0x123, a marked bonus (+0x12f), and a team-relationship discount at +0x121.
results.summary: Computes a numeric priority weight for how attractive a potential threat/target is, combining class, distance, occupancy and relationship factors.

results.name: actor_get_flee_direction_source
results.evidence: Switches on a flee-reason code (0-6) selecting the source point/direction: a stored flee point (+0x504/+0x518), the nearest threat via datum_get, current facing vectors, a caller point, a danger-zone center (+0x2b0), or an arbitrary object's position via object_try_and_get/object_get_position/FUN_00568f50; normalizes and reports success.
results.summary: Resolves the source point/direction to flee away from, based on a caller-selected flee-reason code.

results.name: actor_is_direction_within_forward_cone
results.evidence: Normalizes a 2D vector (in_EAX) and checks whether its dot product with a second vector (in_EDX) is at least param_1 - a forward-cone/angle threshold test.
results.summary: Tests whether a 2D direction lies within a given angular cone of another direction.

results.name: actor_is_position_within_lane
results.evidence: Similar dot-product cone test as actor_is_direction_within_forward_cone but between two points/vectors (in_EAX, in_ECX) plus a forward direction (in_EDX) and a per-side threshold table (param_2), also calling vector2d_normalize_with_length on the offset - consistent with testing whether a point is within a directional firing lane.
results.summary: Tests whether one point lies within a directional lane/cone relative to another point and forward direction, using per-side angular thresholds.

results.name: actor_find_best_grenade_avoid_lane
results.evidence: Walks the actor's nearby-threat list (+0x50) scoring each valid entry (class 2/3, marked) by a time-decayed weight (fields +0x54/+0x58 vs game time +0x5c), filtering via actor_is_direction_within_forward_cone/actor_is_position_within_lane depending on param_2, and keeping the highest-weighted match.
results.summary: Scans nearby recognized threats for the best-weighted one matching lane/direction criteria, used to pick which threat to react or dodge to.

results.name: actor_setup_grenade_avoid_response
results.evidence: Calls actor_find_best_grenade_avoid_lane (unless overridden) to find a reaction threat, computes yaw/pitch avoidance bounds from definition table fields (+0xac/+0xcc, +0xa4/+0xc4, or a fixed pi range), invokes FUN_00415260 to compute an evasive movement target, and on success requests a matching reaction via FUN_00415150, recording it active at +0x55c/+0x55d.
results.summary: Sets up the actor's evasive response to a nearby dangerous threat, computing turn bounds and requesting the appropriate dodge/avoid movement.
